name: Mondronen howlpack
description: A howlpack of about sixty known for dark magic, dissolved after Avacyn's return.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and Tovolar fall out when she refuses to join in slaughtering foresters; she challenges him for command of the howlpack, they wound each other and she flees.
timeline.quote: Arlinn turned on her mentor, challenging Tovolar for command of the howlpack

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Avacyn is freed from the Helvault, the Mondronen and other howlpacks are disbanded, chased off and hunted by angels.
timeline.quote: When Avacyn was set free from The Helvault

timeline.summary: After Avacyn's return the Mondronen howlpack is dissolved.
timeline.quote: After the return of Avacyn, the howlpack was dissolved.
